title: 5,10-Methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase gene variants and congenital anomalies: a HuGE review - PubMed
abstract: May 1, 2000 - Some data suggest that the risk for spina bifida associated with C677T homozygosity may depend on nutritional status (e.g., blood folate levels, intake of vitamins) or on the genotype of other folate-related genes (e.g., cystathionine-beta-synthase and methionine synthase reductase).
